newsitem.title: USA: Trump Atlantic City casino revs rise.
newsitem.headline: Trump Atlantic City casino revs rise.

text.p: Trump Taj Mahal Casino Resort said Friday its gaming revenues were $57.4 million for September, compared to $46.4 million for September 1995, an increase of 23.8 percent.
The company said it was the highest grossing month of any casino in the history of gaming in Atlantic City in September, based on figures released by the Casino Association of New Jersey.

Trump Plaza Hotel & Casino, including Trump World's Fair, was the second highest grossing casino with $34.5 million in September, 1996, revenues, compared to $25.9 million in September, 1995 revenues, an increase of over 33 percent. Both companies are owned by Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts, Inc.
